description: Recent issues + PRs in browserbase/stagehand (golden-replay fixture for Layer 2). Per item: number, title, html_url, state, updated_at.

observe.expect: size(result) > 0 && "number" in result[0] && "title" in result[0] && "html_url" in result[0]

return: {"outcome": dyn(size(observe.body) > 0 ? "ok" : "empty"), "reason": dyn(size(observe.body) > 0 ? "" : "issues list came back empty"), "count": dyn(size(observe.body)), "issues": dyn(observe.body.map(i, {"number": dyn(i.number), "title": dyn(i.title), "html_url": dyn(i.html_url), "state": dyn(i.state), "updated_at": dyn(i.updated_at)}))}
